nodes.label: Ecology
nodes.question: What phenomenon does habitat alteration lead to according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Habitat alteration can lead to Winner-Loser-Replacements (WLRs), where a few winning species outcompete many losing species.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Wildlife conservation|Wildlife habitat enhancement_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: How does habitat alteration affect species in adjacent intact habitats?
nodes.answer: Habitat alteration directly affects species in the altered habitat and indirectly affects species in adjacent intact habitats.
